reason: We have to replace E-Golf4U soon and this is the one decision the board cannot get wrong. The offer is generous and the pilot costs nothing, but I won't put 950 members on software from two founders that no club runs yet. I'd go with Nexxchange or IntoGolf, or wait until Zwolle has been live for a season.
objection: Two people and not one club live yet. The escrow and the exports are nice on paper, but if it falls over halfway through the competition season, I'm the one the members' meeting blames. On top of that, half our older members won't install an app, clinics or no clinics.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing Golfclub Zwolle live with real numbers (members active in the app, invoices collected without problems) and hearing their board say over the phone that the switch went smoothly.
